# WK18 · Cảnh báo agent

Group **WK · Agent chăm sóc (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/care/alerts`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Care administration, tab 5: alerts about the care agents: red flags, use of the 24/24 number, agents lowered in autonomy, patients who keep not replying.

## Agent and care context
- The four alert kinds are the ones PLAN-AI01-M section 12 lists for the administration area; a system-wide alert has no patient ("Toàn hệ thống").

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `care.admin`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Cảnh báo agent" in the section "Care agent", shown when the role holds any of `care.admin`.

## Key actions
- Patient-name link to the care timeline
- Refreshes when `care.changed` arrives

## Logic source
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/admin/care/alerts/page.tsx`
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/components/ops/live-status.tsx`
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/lib/care/labels.ts`
- Test: none.
- Screens of package M (PLAN-AI01-M): every patient is paired with one care agent that follows the treatment journey, decides whether to answer or hand over, picks the right staff member and changes person when nobody answers. Staff move from "controlling" to "supervising": two actions are left, accept or decline a handoff, and return the conversation to the agent.
- Two areas: care administration under `/admin/care/*` (menu section "Care agent": skills and shifts, 24/24 on-call numbers, depth matrix, SLA and send window, alerts) and per-patient supervision under `/care/*` (handoff queue, timeline, return to agent, tell the agent).
- How to reach it (mock BE, `pnpm dev:mock`): sign in as the mock account `owner` → open `/admin/care/alerts`; it must show "Cảnh báo".

- Toàn hệ thống

## Business rules
- Control state per patient: AUTO (the agent answers or acts by its autonomy level L0 to L2; staff supervise the timeline and approve drafts) → HANDOFF_ROUTING (the agent is silent towards the patient except one template holding message, summarises for the candidate, runs the routing loop) → STAFF (the agent does not react, sends no scheduled reminders; it observes and drafts suggestions that are not sent). Only a staff member returns a conversation to AUTO (PLAN-AI01-M section 5).
- The agent decides to hand over by itself (skill `handoff`): depth D1 administrative, D2 standard care, D3 mild expected symptom, D4 medical judgement, D5 red flag. Defaults: D1 answers from L1, D2 answers from L2 with a source, D3 draft plus approval, D4 always calls a person, D5 calls a doctor at once without calling the model. The matrix that holds these numbers is configuration and carries "Chờ bác sĩ duyệt" until a doctor approves it (section 6).
- The candidate chain is 3 to 5 people and its last element is always the 24/24 on-call Zalo number, kept in the database, never in code. Default SLA: urgent 5 minutes, normal 30 minutes, outside working hours until the start of the next shift (section 7).
